Job Description
We are seeking a motivated Inspection Engineer to join our Marine Asset Integrity (MAI) Service Line. This is an excellent opportunity for a driven individual looking to advance their career within the evolving Geo-data industry.
In this role, you will support both onshore and offshore project preparation activities, including the setup of online data recording systems, offline data editing, and quality control for structural and pipeline inspections.
While offshore, you will collaborate closely with a multidisciplinary team of Inspectors, Surveyors, Engineers, Data Processors, and ROV personnel to ensure the effective operation of inspection and survey equipment, and the accurate, efficient collection of data. You will maintain regular communication with the onboard team and, when necessary, with clients.
You will also work in partnership with the MAI Client Deliverables Team based in Aberdeen, who will provide continuous support throughout the project lifecycle.
Every role here at Fugro plays a vital part in the success, safety, and growth of our business and our staff, and you, as an Inspection Engineer, are no different.
Your role and responsibilities:
•
Ensure the safe, efficient and profitable execution of all ROV platform and vessel-based pipeline and structural inspections.
•
QC of Inspection data recording, quality control of real-time video data and ensuring that, where required, all data sheets are completed accurately.
•
Ensure anomalies identified during online and offline inspections are accurately recorded and reported to the Inspection Coordinator, Superintendent/OVM and Client in a timely manner determined by the magnitude of the finding and anomaly criteria.
•
Assist in project reporting and delivery in accordance with Fugro and client specifications and document control parameters; document any variations to the workscope or procedures and inform the Client Deliverables department.
•
Promote teamwork at the worksite among all associated parties and ensure good communication lines, especially during shift handovers.
•
Ensure awareness, understanding and control of all computer operating systems relating to the content of the project or contract.
•
Ensure inspection equipment calibration procedures are followed and/or undertaken by third parties. Where necessary, compile and check data from these other sources such as Cathodic
What you’ll need to thrive in this role:
•
Formal qualifications to a minimum of HND level in Engineering or IT.

CSWIP 3.4u or 3.3u.

Offshore experience working with ROVs as an Inspection Engineer and/or Coordinator in UKCS.

MS Office experience.

Good IT skills.

Ability to understand technical engineering drawings.

Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude.

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. Studio Overview
We are Sports Interactive 🎮
The studio behind: ⚽ Football Manager.
Founded in 1994, Sports Interactive became a wholly owned subsidiary of SEGA Europe in 2006. Based at the Here East technology hub in Stratford, East London, the SI team continues to expand as we bring our titles to an ever-growing audience across an increasing variety of platforms.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Match AI & Simulation)
Team: Match
Reporting into: Lead Software Engineer (Match AI)
Working Model: Hybrid 2-3 days | Remote by exception
Location: Here East, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, London, E15 2GW
Position Overview
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Match AI & Simulation) to join our London-based studio to enhance our match simulation and help us take our football match engine to the next level. The match engine team is responsible for the technological advancements of our state-of-the-art in-house engine which simulates football matches.
You will join a passionate and flourishing team who care deeply about the authenticity and depth of the match simulation in our games. As part of this team, you will be working on the game AI and core systems that drive our match simulation, which is used across multiple projects and products. This covers everything from the AI that controls the agents on the pitch, their decision-making, positioning, and tactical behaviours through to the rules of the simulation, pathing, collisions, and game state management.
Your primary focus will be on improving the architecture and performance of the match simulation, with particular emphasis on the game AI systems that drive agent behaviour. You will refactor existing systems from flat, tightly coupled structures into modern, maintainable paradigms such as behaviour trees, finite state machines, and utility-based systems. You will also build and maintain our in-house debugging and visualisation tools to ensure designers and engineers can rapidly iterate on and understand AI-driven agent behaviour.
You will collaborate closely with designers, QA, producers, and other engineering teams in a studio where football expertise runs, giving you rich, authentic context to draw on as you build the systems that power the simulation. You will have full input into the team specifically as well as the studio generally, with the opportunity to voice your ideas and suggestions.
Our match simulation is shared across multiple products and is a critical part of the games we make, and you will consider challenges involving the match experience across several platforms, including on mobile devices.
We are looking for self-motivated, proactive people with good communication skills who can complete work independently as well as part of a team, and who actively seek out opportunities to improve systems and drive change rather than waiting for direction.
Key Responsibilities
•
Develop, extend, improve, and maintain our match simulation codebase, workflows, and tools.
•
Design and implement game AI systems for match agents, including decision-making, positioning, rules enforcement, and tactical behaviours, using techniques such as behaviour trees, finite state machines, utility-based systems, and other classical video-game AI approaches.
•
Refactor and modernise AI-driven agent decision-making systems, moving from flat, monolithic class structures into modern, maintainable game AI architectures.
•
Build and maintain debugging and visualisation tools using our in-house ImGUI-based tooling to support rapid iteration and clear understanding of agent AI behaviour.
•
Collaborate with other disciplines, including designers, QA, producers, and other engineering teams, on both development and future planning.
•
Work closely with seniors/leads and production to drive new features and set the long-term roadmap.
•
Help research and implement new simulation technologies, game AI techniques, and architectural patterns as needed.
•
Consider cross-platform and performance requirements, including the need for deterministic simulation across platforms.
Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
•
Keen interest and understanding in Football. Football Manager fan a bonus.
•
Strong knowledge of C++, design patterns and software engineering.
•
Minimum five years of professional experience using C++ as the main language.
•
Professional experience designing and developing game AI systems and simulation paradigms within the games industry, including hands-on work with behaviour trees, finite state machines, utility-based systems, or similar classical video-game AI techniques.
•
Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
•
Good communication skills for effective collaboration with software engineers, designers, QA, and production staff.
•
Self-motivated and proactive with a drive to improve yourself, seize ownership, and push systems forward rather than waiting for direction.
•
Experience with C# and Unity is beneficial.
•
Experience with, or strong appreciation for, deterministic simulation systems are highly desirable.
•
Familiarity with Python and/or ImGUI is a plus.

Travel Insurance for yourself and your family.

Ensure all assigned work is completed within established regulatory and internal service level agreements while maintaining high quality standards.

Identify trends, recurring quality issues, and opportunities to enhance narrative consistency, investigative outputs, and reporting effectiveness.

Experience reviewing investigations, AIRs, case documentation, or regulatory reporting submissions.
•
Excellent written communication skills with the ability to translate complex investigative findings into concise and effective regulatory narratives.

Experience interpreting financial crime typologies and identifying suspicious activity indicators.
•
Ability to analyse large volumes of information and exercise sound judgement in a risk-based environment
•

Knowledge of global financial crimes regulations and international reporting requirements.

Job Description:
Every day our teams help people in businesses and communities to do what is right and achieve their goals.
The Transaction Legal Coordinator (Manager) sits within Strategic Advisory, leading the central legal process function across our Debt and Capital Advisory and Transaction Advisory Services teams. Reporting to the Operations Lead for Strategic Advisory, the role has overall accountability for the coordination, preparation and execution of NDAs, release letters, hold harmless letters and related transaction documentation across live engagements. The Manager oversees the work of the Assistant Manager in the team, acts as the senior escalation point on complex or non-standard documentation matters, and builds and maintains the firm’s relationships with clients, counterparty legal teams and internal risk and legal stakeholders. This is a senior coordination role requiring strong legal process knowledge, sound commercial judgment and the confidence to represent Grant Thornton in direct dialogue with sophisticated external counterparties on active transactions.
We're happy to talk flexible working and consider reduced hours and job shares, we'll support you to balance your work and life.
A look into the role
As a Transaction Legal Coordinator (Manager) within our Strategic Advisory team, you will:
•
Take ownership of the Strategic Advisory legal documentation function, managing the full lifecycle of NDAs, release letters, hold harmless letters and related documentation across Debt and Capital Advisory and Transaction Advisory Services, overseeing the work of the Assistant Manager, and acting as the senior point of contact for deal teams, clients, lenders and external legal advisers on all documentation matters.
•
Act as the senior point of escalation for complex or non-standard documentation matters, applying judgment on whether mark-ups are acceptable, when to escalate to AQRM or legal, and how to manage counterparty positions that fall outside standard templates.
•
Build and maintain the relationship with AQRM and internal legal teams, acting as the consistent liaison point for risk and legal approval workflows, reducing delays and inconsistency across engagements, and engaging directly with counterparty legal teams to negotiate and resolve documentation positions on live transactions.
•
Drive process improvement and standardisation across the legal documentation function, developing and maintaining templates, trackers and standard operating procedures that create consistency and reduce turnaround time across the business.
•
Identify and implement improvements to documentation processes and turnaround times, working with deal teams to identify friction points, refine templates and standard operating procedures, and build a more consistent and scalable documentation function across Strategic Advisory.
•
Provide regular reporting to the Operations Lead on documentation volumes, turnaround times and service quality across active engagements, ensuring the function's commercial value is clearly tracked and evidenced for SLT.ensuring the function is delivering consistently and identifying areas for further improvement.
Knowing you're right for us
Joining us as a Transaction Legal Coordinator (Manager), the minimum criteria you'll need is:
•
Demonstrated experience in a legal, paralegal or legal process management role, with the ability to handle complex and non-standard documentation matters.
•
Holds a recognised legal qualification (LLB, GDL, or equivalent), or is a qualified solicitor/barrister, relevant to the demands of the role.
•
Experience in a financial services professional services environment
•
Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent matters, prioritise effectively and maintain accuracy under time pressure.
•
Experience advising or coordinating with internal risk, compliance or legal stakeholders on documentation or approval workflows.
•
Strong judgment on when to escalate and when to resolve, with the confidence to engage directly with counterparty legal teams where required.
•
Clear and confident communicator, able to brief senior stakeholders on documentation status and risks without unnecessary jargon.
It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don't worry if you don't tick every box, we'll help you develop along the way.
•
Familiarity with NDA processes, release letters or duty of care letters in a transaction, financial advisory or professional services context.
•
Experience working in or alongside deal teams on live M&A, debt advisory or restructuring engagements.
•
Exposure to AQRM or equivalent internal risk and legal approval frameworks.
•
Experience designing or improving legal process workflows, including templates, trackers and standard operating procedures.
•
A track record of engaging directly with clients and external legal advisers in a transactions or professional services environment, with the confidence to manage those relationships independently.
Knowing we're right for you
Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone. Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.
Our open and accessible culture means you'll interact with leaders who are interested in you and everything you bring to our firm. The things that set you apart, we value them. That's why we give you the freedom to bring your whole self to work and pursue your passions inside and outside of work.
Beyond the job
Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you're with outside of work matter, that's why we're happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we'll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.
The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you'll be giving back to society. It's that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm's values – purposefully…

Job Description:
We are currently looking for Manager, Medical Affairs - International (m/f/d) to join our Medical Affairs Department.
This is a field-based role available within Germany, Belgium and the UK depending on the final candidate's location.
Position Overview
The Manager, Medical Affairs – International (m/f/d) ​is a field-based member of the OMA (Office of Medical Affairs) team located in Europe (Belgium, Germany, UK). This role will support the development of professional relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOL) in the therapeutic areas of Shockwave Medical (SWAV) and will provide regional scientific support for OMA and International commercial functions.
This role represents SWAV as a scientific expert at conferences and internal/external meetings, supports HEOR and market access initiatives, reviews promotional materials, and partners with cross-functional teams (Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, Professional Education, Marketing). Additionally, the role will actively support investigator-initiated studies (IISs), facilitating scientific and operational collaborations with investigators, and supporting dissemination and publication of results while ensuring compliance with applicable laws, codes, and company policies.
Key responsibilities
• Support in development of professional and credible relationships with clinical and scientific thought leaders.
• Support investigator‑initiated studies (IISs): Interact with KOLs to ensure the execution of international studies within the IIS program in accordance with applicable regulations and SWAV procedures. Serve as point of contact for regional KOLs to facilitate IIS proposal submissions and research contract execution of approved studies. Conduct timely communications with KOLs and internal stakeholders to monitor enrollment and milestone progression of approved IIS studies.
• Provide appropriate clinical and scientific information for Shockwave Medical products and therapeutic areas in response to unsolicited requests for information.
• Attend relevant scientific meetings and conferences in support of SWAV conference activities representing OMA as the subject matter expert and point of contact for scientific information.
• Support in driving communication and education of internal (e.g. commercial, management) and external (e.g. customers, collaborators, distributors) stakeholder on scientific evidence (out of congresses, adboards, funded/sponsored trials)
• Be a therapeutic expert and provide scientific support for key regional business partners (Clinical Affairs, Regulatory, Marketing, Professional Education and Market Access and HEOR).
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including HEOR, to develop summaries of key data, health economic insights, and other scientifically relevant information to inform SWAV strategic priorities and initiatives.
• Participate in periodic review of clinical reports, abstracts, manuscripts, health economic models/dossiers, and other materials related to scientific and HEOR data and information.
• Support global OMA functions cross-functionally with scientific expertise for e.g. carotids, TAVI, PAD, CAD or coronary physiology
• Support internal training and advisory boards
• Ensure that all activities and interactions are conducted with due regard to all applicable local and national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, company policies and accepted standards of best practice.
• Other duties as assigned.

• Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific field of study. Advance degree preferred (Master, PhD, MD, PharmD, etc.).
• 6+ years of related experience in Medical Affairs in the medical device industry.
• Proficient in English (verbal and written) and at least one additional major European language (preferably French, and/or German).
• Medical device industry experience in cardiovascular medicine with special expertise in carotids, TAVI, PAD, CAD and/or coronary physiology highly preferred.
• Experience supporting HEOR projects, health economics analyses and dossiers.
• Experience in promotional materials review.
• Ability to understand, summarize, and convey scientific data in a clear and concise manner.
• Ability to develop and maintain key opinion leader relationships.
• Works effectively independently and on cross-functional teams.
• Effective written, verbal and presentation skills across various audiences.
• Operate as a team or independently while maintaining flexibility and resilience.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook) software.
• High attention to detail and accuracy, excellent critical thinking skills.
• Good prioritization and organizational skills.
• Entrepreneurial “hands-on” experience. Pro-active and a “can do” attitude.
• Flexibility and strong ability to work in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
• Ability to travel up to 50% of the time depending on business need.

• Delivering personalised, one-to-one guidance to our participants including CV writing, interview preparation, and skills development.
• Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Working Together
• Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.
• Engaging with local employers to identify job opportunities.
• Signposting participants to internal and external stakeholders to address specific barriers such as health, housing, or financial challenges.
• Promoting the Restart Scheme within the community, raising awareness of it's benefits and impact.
Being Fair, Open, and Honest
• Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:
• 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays

• Award Winning Management & Leadership training
• Professional & Personal Development Funds
• Bi-annual pay reviews
• Plus much more that can be found on our website.

Corporate Title:  Assistant Vice President / Vice President

Company Overview:
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
Being a Great Place to Work is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. This includes our commitment to being an inclusive workplace, attracting and developing exceptional talent, supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness, recognizing and rewarding performance, and how we make an impact in the communities we serve.
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture with specific requirements for office-based attendance and which allows for an appropriate level of flexibility for our teammates and businesses based on role-specific considerations.
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
Location Overview:
Our London office is based just a stone’s throw from the magnificent St. Paul’s Cathedral on bustling King Edward Street. Here you’ll find modern workspaces and a state-of-the-art auditorium space. In addition, we’re proud to host an onsite restaurant that shares our commitment to sustainability by providing delicious seasonal menus which have been created with the planet in mind. Make sure to take time for yourself and head up to our rooftop terrace and take in the spectacular views across London. Finally, your physical wellness is well-catered for with our onsite gym facilities and medical centre.

• The London-based UK Corporate Secretary team sits within the Legal department and comprises of eight governance professionals.
• The team supports the governance of Merrill Lynch International (MLI) and works across the EMEA subsidiary governance portfolio, which comprises approximately 80 regulated and unregulated entities across EMEA.
• The team works closely with the wider EMEA Corporate Secretary team, particularly colleagues in Dublin and Paris, to share expertise, coordinate cross-border governance matters and provide consistent, high-quality support across the portfolio.

• Support the maintenance of statutory registers, minute books, governance databases, templates and electronic and physical records.
• Use Diligent Boards, Microsoft 365 and approved artificial intelligence tools to prepare meeting materials, maintain records and support governance workflows securely and efficiently.

• Proficiency in Diligent Boards and Microsoft 365; experience using Copilot or other approved AI tools
• Previous company secretarial, governance, legal or administrative experience is helpful but not essential.

We want to maximise peoples independence so individuals can achieve their goals and aspirations and live life to the fullest. We work creatively with individuals, local communities and our partners, empowering them to deliver the best possible outcomes for people and to create a positive Adult Social Care culture. Our work is solution focussed, ensuring that those who most need support receive it and that we can continue supporting people in the future. Attend multidisciplinary meetings with stakeholders for the purpose of best interest outcomes for the people we provide care and support to. Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.
Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.
We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow. That’s why we are ‘Investors for a new now’.
As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.
This is your chance to invest in your future.
Team / division overview
The DWS Alternatives business is a diversified set of business activities with €114bn in assets under management in strategies including Private Real Estate, Private Infrastructure, Liquid Real Assets (Real Estate/Infrastructure and Commodity Securities) and Sustainable Investments.  The global team invests on behalf of a global client base that includes governments, corporations, individuals and institutional investors.
The DWS Private Infrastructure business (“DWS Infrastructure”), acquires and manages Debt and Equity investments in businesses that provide essential Infrastructure services in the transport, energy, utilities, digital, circular economy and healthcare sectors.  With investment teams located in Europe and the US, the business has a global footprint and is focused on managing infrastructure portfolios that can meet the needs of institutional investors and private clients worldwide. The division has funds under management of approximately €15 billion.
DWS Infrastructure manages two strategies targeting private equity investments in European infrastructure companies: the “Pan European Infrastructure Fund (“PEIF”)” series and “Sustainable Growth Infrastructure Fund (“SGIF”)”. PEIF invests in core plus infrastructure in the mid-cap size bracket and SGIF is a value add strategy, providing growth capital to lower mid-cap infrastructure companies who are seeking to scale their sustainable business models.

Appraisal of potential infrastructure investment opportunities across Europe

Leading the due diligence and acquisition processes for new investments including liaising with financial advisers, lawyers, tax specialists and other experts, both internally and externally
•
Commercial assessment and recommendation of the merits of investment opportunities based on an analysis of the risk and return fundamentals
•
Building, reviewing and updating financial models in order to provide valuation analysis and recommendations
•
Conducting asset management activities, working closely with portfolio company management teams, including monitoring and reporting the performance of portfolio assets through the life-cycle to realisation of the asset
•
Supporting future fund-raising processes including providing support to answer investor queries and providing accurate asset information on a timely basis
•
Leading on the preparation and presentation of investment committee papers as well as portfolio valuation/asset management reports
We are looking for:
•
Previous experience in either Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A), Leveraged Finance, Private Equity or Transaction Advisory with a focus on Infrastructure, Industrials, Natural Resources, Energy, Transportation or ither relevant sectors
•
Sound knowledge of the full investment life cycle from origination and acquisition to the asset management and disposal of portfolio companies
•
Working knowledge of Infrastructure and other related sectors across mainland Europe
•
Very strong analytical skills including cash flow modelling
•
Commercially focused with demonstrable investment acumen, excellent communication skills, both written and verbal with a high level of attention to detail
•
Educated to Bachelor’s degree level within a related financial subject or with relevant professional experience
•
Ability to work under pressure to meet tight deadlines and strong project management skills
•
Proficiency in another European language would be beneficial (but not essential)

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.
Some of our core benefits:

30 days’ holiday + bank holidays, with the option to purchase additional days
•
A non-contributory pension scheme, up to 10%

Physical and Mental Health Well-Being benefits including (but not limited to) Private Medical Cover, a complimentary GP service and the support of Mental Health First Aiders
•
Family friendly benefits including generous parental leave packages (supporting all variations of family set-ups), to healthcare plans and travel insurance
•
The opportunity to support our CSR strategy which is focused on combatting climate change and achieving greater social justice. You can make donations to our partner organisations or take part in corporate volunteering opportunities in your local communities by providing on hand support.
DWS’ Hybrid Working model in the UK is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Employees who wish to sign-up to our Hybrid Working model are required to work in the office two days a week, and given the flexibility to work from home for the remaining three.

NEW GROUND WON'T BREAK ITSELF.
A look into the role
We're looking for a Director to support our Media and Entertainment tax team. You'll work with a broad range of clients across the sector, providing corporate tax advisory and compliance services, and bringing together deep technical knowledge of creative industry reliefs with broader corporate tax expertise.
One day you might be getting into the detail of a Creative Industry Tax Relief claim; the next, you're in the boardroom talking through what an international restructuring or a sale process means for a client's next production or investment round. Portfolio leadership
• Supporting our portfolio of corporate tax compliance and provision engagements, with particular responsibility for complex Creative Industry Tax Relief claims across TV, film and video games

Audit of tax

Tax structuring and advisory
• Advising media clients on tax structuring, including international expansion and migration of operations and rights
• Providing Enterprise Investment Scheme advice to clients raising investment into qualifying media and entertainment ventures
Transactions
• Supporting the transactions practice on deal structuring and tax diligence for media companies, including sell-side advisory, and bringing your sector knowledge to bear on the specific risks and reliefs that shape media deals
People and team
• Managing, coaching and developing a team of tax professionals, and taking an active role in their technical training and career progression
• Setting the standard for quality and technical rigour across the team's output
• Playing a part in recruitment and resourcing decisions for the media tax team
Operations
• Owning financial performance for your portfolio, including billing, recoveries and WIP management
• Making sure engagements are risk-managed appropriately and in line with firm policy
• Contributing to the wider operational running of the tax service line
Business development and market presence
• Building and maintaining a network of contacts across the media sector, including intermediaries, industry bodies and target clients
• Spotting and converting new business opportunities within existing and new clients
• Representing the firm at industry events and contributing to thought leadership on media sector tax matters
• Working with colleagues across the firm to spot cross-selling opportunities
Knowing you're right for us
Ideally, we're looking for someone who is fully tax qualified and comfortable leading an engagement across the entire corporate tax role - compliance, provision, advisory and reliefs. That said, subject to the wider business case, we'd also welcome a candidate whose strength is signing off Creative Industry Tax Relief claims, working alongside a Tax Partner or Director to cover the rest of the corporate tax scope.
• CTA and/or ACA qualified (or equivalent), with significant post-qualification experience in corporate tax
• Strong technical knowledge of Creative Industry Tax Reliefs across TV, film and video games
• Experience advising on tax structuring, including international expansion and migration
• A track record of managing complex compliance and advisory engagements, ideally including audit of tax work
• Experience supporting transactions, including sell-side advisory and tax diligence
• Familiarity with Enterprise Investment Scheme rules and how they apply to media and entertainment clients is an advantage
• Proven people management experience, with a genuine interest in developing others
• Existing relationships or credibility within the media and entertainment sector are an advantage
• Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to advise senior stakeholders and represent the firm externally
Knowing we're right for you
This is a role with real scope to shape our media tax offering, backed by the firm's national tax network and sector specialists across audit and advisory. You'll have autonomy to build your own client relationships and market presence, genuine investment in your development as a leader, and a team that will back you to do it.
Beyond the job
Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you're with outside of work matter, that's why we're happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we'll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.
The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you'll be giving back to society. It's that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm's values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.
We're looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what's right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It's how it should be.

Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define use cases, and prioritise work based on commercial value

Design, develop, and deploy scalable machine learning, predictive analytics, and AI applications

Drive technical best practices across data science, experimentation, model development, MLOps, and software engineering

Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Platform, and Product teams to deliver production-grade solutions

Contribute to the evolution of Howden's AI and data science capabilities, standards, and ways of working

Excellent Python programming skills and hands on experience with libraries such as XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face

Strong problem-solving skills and a commercial mindset, with a focus on outcomes rather than models alone

Experience with Generative AI, LLM applications, agentic systems

Exposure to mentoring or coaching other data scientists and technical practitioners

Develop clear, stable and well-documented APIs according to the Roche quality processes and regulatory requirements.

Collaborate with project teams to understand common needs and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.

Review technical designs and code, identify architectural risks and promote consistent engineering practices.

Plan and perform software unit verification tests depending on the role as developer or development tester of a specific component from the One diagnostics Platform
•
Develop robust automated tests, including unit, integration and UI tests where appropriate.

Investigate complex technical issues affecting multiple applications and provide sustainable solutions rather than isolated fixes.

Contribute to secure software design, protection of sensitive data and appropriate handling of application permissions according to regulatory guidelines.

High proficiency in Kotlin and strong experience in Java.
•
Extensive background in building Android applications, shared software components, system-level architecture, and Gradle build systems.

Practical experience using AI-assisted tools within software development workflows.

Solid experience with unit and integration test automation and pipeline integration (Azure DevOps/GitHub).

Professional fluency in English (written and verbal).

Familiarity with healthcare/MedTech software regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 81001-5-1).

Experience with threat modeling, secure data handling, design controls, and regulatory submission documentation.

The opportunity to build software that supports medical diagnostics and contributes to better healthcare.

Significant technical ownership without requiring a people-management career path.

Collaboration with experienced engineers and specialists across software, systems, quality, regulatory and cybersecurity.

The opportunity to shape reusable technologies used across multiple products.

A professional environment that values engineering quality, continuous learning and thoughtful technical decision-making.

• Electrical distribution and standby power systems
• UPS and DRUPS systems
• Chillers, compressors and air-handling units

• Stop unsafe work and escalate significant risks immediately.

• Improved asset reliability and availability.
• Reduction in reactive maintenance and repeat failures.
• Delivery of the planned maintenance programme.
• Reduced maintenance-related production interruptions.
• Completion of statutory inspections and compliance actions on time.

• Delivery of maintenance activities within budget.

Job Description
Technical Architect, AI-Powered Customer Experience
Why This Role? Why Now?
Customer experience is being transformed by AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we’re not just responding to that shift — we’re leading it. As we expand our AI-powered Resolution Platform and deepen our Professional Services capabilities, the Technical Architect, AI-Powered Customer Experience role is critical to helping customers design, implement, and scale intelligent customer service solutions that deliver measurable business value.
As a technical expert, solution designer, and trusted advisor, you will help customers translate business goals into scalable AI-first architectures. You’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, remove technical roadblocks, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Zendesk AI capabilities.
Overarching Objective for the Role
Accelerate customers’ time-to-value by designing and enabling AI-first Zendesk solutions that drive adoption, automation, and measurable business impact from discovery through scale.
Be the customer’s AI technical architect. Turn business goals into the right architecture, integrations, workflows, and AI design choices.
Lead high-quality solution discovery and delivery. Run technical discovery sessions, define solution scope, and guide customers through implementation with clarity and confidence.
Remove blockers fast. Anticipate risks, resolve constraints, and keep customer solutions moving toward successful outcomes.
How You’ll Make an Impact
Strategic Accountabilities
• AI Solution Architecture: Design scalable, supportable, and secure AI-first architectures that enable automation, self-service, agent assist, intelligent routing, and other Zendesk AI use cases.
• AI Adoption Enablement: Guide customers through rollout planning, change considerations, and operational readiness to support long-term AI adoption while leveraging AI tools to enhance individual and team workflows for greater efficiency.
• Outcome Orientation: Ensure solution decisions are tied to measurable improvements in containment, deflection, productivity, resolution speed, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency.
• Technical Discovery & Use Case Definition: Lead customer-facing discovery sessions to understand business challenges, technical constraints, and high-value AI opportunities.
• Customer Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers make informed decisions about architecture, integrations, data readiness, and implementation tradeoffs.
• Implementation Leadership: Partner with delivery teams to translate solution designs into successful implementations, ensuring technical quality, alignment to scope, and strong execution.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Product, and Professional Services to align on customer strategy, risks, dependencies, and roadmap considerations.
• Integration & Extensibility: Identify opportunities to extend Zendesk through APIs, app framework solutions, automation, and custom integrations where needed.
• Problem Solving & Innovation: Diagnose product gaps, technical constraints, or workflow limitations and recommend validated workarounds or design alternatives that preserve business outcomes.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
Strategic Skills & Expertise
• Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences in English and German is a must.
• AI-First Thinking: Strong understanding of how AI capabilities can be applied across the customer service journey to improve efficiency, quality, and experience

NEW GROUND WON’T BREAK ITSELF.

What's more, businesses now face complex VAT systems, case law, guidance and legislation. Companies need to comply with thorny VAT rules when entering new markets, stretching out globally or joining international supply chains. Meanwhile, liabilities, errors and assessments can also attract interest and penalties.

•
Be responsible for the scoping, delivery and billing of client work. Delivering high quality technical advice, working with a diverse range of clients
•
Ensure that junior staff are guided in researching and producing work that meets the firm’s commitment to quality, whilst also supporting the Directors and Partners.
•
Provide technically accurate advice on a range of Indirect Tax matters, supporting your decisions with appropriate knowledge of legislation, case law, and technical analysis.
•

Produce technical work which requires minimal review and conveys key points to clients and stakeholders.
•
Review the work of other members of the team.
•
Be compliant with the firm’s risk management processes for clients starting from initial take on to completion of assignments.
•
Take responsibility for financial hygiene including billing, gross margin, utilisation, WIP management.

You’d probably also hold a relevant tax qualification (CTA / ATT). It would be great if you had some of the following skills, but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box, we’ll help you develop along the way.
•
Experience of managing a large and varied portfolio of indirect / VAT tax clients.
•
Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills required because you will be working with a number of different colleagues at any given time on work for a great many different clients and targets.
•
Excellent inter-personal skills and be able to demonstrate that you are able to forge long standing business relationships.
•
Comfortable when working as part of a mixed discipline team to take the lead and drive forward a project to its conclusion.
•
Experience of advising on complex technical indirect tax matters across a range of VAT areas and sectors.
Knowing we’re right for you
Embracing uniqueness, the culture at Grant Thornton thrives on the contributions of all our people, we never settle for what is easy, we look beyond to deliver the right thing, for everyone.  Building an inclusive culture, where we value difference and respect our colleagues helps our people to perform at the best of their ability and realise their potential.

Beyond the job
Life is more than work. The things you do, and the people you’re with outside of work matter, that’s why we’re happy to look at flexible working options for all our roles, and we’ll always do our best to keep your work and life in balance.  We currently operate a hybrid working model with two days in the office but there is flexibility around this.
The impact you can make here will go far beyond your day job. From secondments, to fundraising for local charities, or investing in entrepreneurs in the developing world, you’ll be giving back to society.
It’s that drive to do the right thing that runs through our every move, grounded in our firm’s values – purposefully driven, actively curious and candid but kind.
We’re looking for people who want to contribute, spark fresh ideas and go beyond expectations. People who want to be able to proudly do what’s right, for the firm, our clients, our people and themselves. It’s how it should be.

2 years. Three rotations.

Let’s go on an adventure together!
Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.
For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.
At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers —  you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.
Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? Not just for travellers — but for the people and places they visit?

Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

You’re not just running a trip.
You’re shaping an experience.
You’re the reason a good tour becomes an unforgettable one.

• Coordinating transport and suppliers
• Sharing the culture, history, and nuance of a place
• Supporting community partners
• Helping travellers feel like they truly belong
You’re not just guiding people through a destination. You’re helping them understand it.

You don’t just do the job — you live it.

• Champion G for Good and our Raise the World efforts on tour

• Bring calm, positivity, and energy to long, unpredictable days

• Promote Planeterra and G for Good initiatives

You won’t sit behind a desk.
You won’t have two days that look the same.
You won’t just be guiding tours.
You’ll be creating moments travellers talk about for the rest of their lives — while helping the people and places you visit, too.
If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we can’t wait to meet you.

As a Senior Analyst, Global Trade Compliance, you will support and strengthen Illumina's trade compliance operations across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). • Investigate and resolve customs and trade-related issues, including shipment delays and documentation discrepancies
• Prepare compliance reports, metrics, and documentation for management and regulatory requirements
• Drive process improvements, automation initiatives, and operational efficiencies within trade compliance
• Support trade compliance training and awareness programmes
• Collaborate with global trade compliance colleagues to ensure regional alignment with corporate policies and standards

• Bachelor's degree in International Trade, Supply Chain, Business, Law, Finance, or a related discipline
• Experience in trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or global trade management

• Practical experience with tariff classification, customs valuation, origin determination, and customs broker management
• Knowledge of EU dual-use regulations, UK export controls, and sanctions compliance frameworks is advantageous
• Experience working within multinational and matrixed organisations
• Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving skills
• Advanced Excel skills and experience working with ERP systems; SAP GTS experience is highly desirable
• Professional trade compliance or customs certifications are beneficial
• Fluent English communication skills

The Opportunity
We are seeking an intern to join our European Supply Chain team, based in Folkestone, Kent on a 12-month contract commencing in Summer 2027.  This is a great location on the Kent coast, with easy access to both London and the Channel Tunnel; we even have sea views from our logistics main office!

• Collaborating cross functionally with Sales & Marketing to gain market insights to shape and inform the demand plan.
• Helping to drive forecast accuracy improvements, by enhancing reporting and data analytics tools - with a key focus on E-Commerce.
• Helping to drive logistics efficiency using our SAP platform
• Stock control and inventory management from raw materials through to finished products held in the UK and in our European locations
• Implementation and measurement of Lean within both warehouse and desk based roles
• Digital automation of routine transactions in both warehouse and desk based roles, reducing touch points and improving customer experience
• Expanding our D2C provision
• Integration of newly acquired brands into our own logistics network in Europe.
In this role you will work with multiple functions across the organization and liaise with external stakeholders such at third party logistics providers and fulfilment houses.  You will have the opportunity to spend blocks of the internship year with different parts of Supply Chain, so gain a deeper knowledge of each specific area – UK logistics, European logistics, customer fulfilment and direct to consumer.  You will become proficient in SAP logistics transactions and have the opportunity to visit third party sites for inventory counts and project meetings.
Our ideal candidate will be articulate and commercially aware, have an enquiring mind and be able to work on their own initiative. You must also be numerate and have experience interpreting data and spreadsheets.  As you will be liaising with both internal and external stakeholders, we also expect that you will be a great ambassador for our team at all times.

We welcome applications from current students looking to undertake an industry placement year and also graduates seeking their first Supply Chain opportunity.

• Be able to work as part of teams located in different sites or even countries
• Have excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
• Be able to demonstrate a “can do” attitude and desire to continuously improve.
• Have an enquiring mind and confident disposition
• Have excellent numeracy and IT skills
• Be prepared to get stuck in and learn in the role
About Church & Dwight
You may be more familiar with our products than with our company name. Batiste dry shampoo, Pearl Drops Whitening tooth polish, Arm & Hammer baking soda toothpaste, Femfresh Intimate wash, Orajel toothache & ulcer relief, Sterimar natural sea water nasal spray, Hero Mighty Patch, The Breath Co Mouthwash and Nair hair removal products all of which form part of our exciting brands.
Church & Dwight UK Ltd are based in Folkestone, Kent, where we develop, produce & distribute many of our products and work with Sofibel in Paris and Church & Dwight GmbH in Frankfurt, Germany to form the European team. We are part of Church & Dwight Co. Inc. based in New Jersey, USA.

Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com. Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.
2027 Blackstone Real Estate Partners Summer Analyst – Acquisitions, Asset Management, Capital Markets and Core+ (London)
Blackstone Real Estate
Blackstone is a global leader in real estate investing. Blackstone’s real estate business was founded in 1991 and has US $319 billion of investor capital under management. Blackstone is the largest owner of commercial real estate globally, owning and operating assets across every major geography and sector, including logistics, data centers, residential, office and hospitality. Our opportunistic funds seek to acquire undermanaged, well-located assets across the world. Blackstone’s Core+ business invests in substantially stabilized real estate assets globally, through both institutional strategies and strategies tailored for income-focused individual investors including Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. (BREIT). Blackstone Real Estate also operates one of the leading global real estate debt businesses, providing comprehensive financing solutions across the capital structure and risk spectrum, including management of Blackstone Mortgage Trust (NYSE: BXMT).
Programme Description
Blackstone's Summer Analyst Program is a 10 week in-person experience, offering participants extensive exposure across the firm. This program provides Summer Analysts with valuable guidance through mentorship, continuous feedback, technical and soft skill training, networking opportunities with professionals across the firm and the unique chance to fully immerse themselves in Blackstone's culture.
Blackstone Real Estate Partners is seeking 2027 Summer Analysts to join the following groups:
•
Real Estate Acquisitions
•
Real Estate Asset Management
•
Real Estate Capital Markets
•
Real Estate Core+
Please see information regarding groups below:
Real Estate Acquisitions
Blackstone’s Real Estate Acquisitions Group focuses on originating, underwriting and executing real estate investment opportunities. As a Summer Analyst you will get a holistic exposure to the real estate private equity investment process and become part of deal teams working on the acquisition of real estate companies, portfolios and individual properties across multiple asset classes and throughout Europe.
Summer Analyst work may include:
•
Conducting financial analysis and market research to formulate new investment theses
•
Preparing valuation analyses, LBO models, memos and presentations for ongoing investment opportunities
•
Assisting in the due diligence, negotiation, execution, financing and structuring of live transactions
•
Collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Asset Management, Legal & Compliance, and Capital Markets (among others)
•
Attending site tours, internal and external meetings, as well as due diligence and expert sessions
•
Preparing and presenting a view on the key drivers, risks, and opportunities of a potential transaction
Real Estate Asset Management
Blackstone’s Real Estate Asset Management Group (‘AM’) leads all post-acquisition investment activities. AM’s investment professionals oversee the full lifecycle of an investment, including setting business plans, identifying value creation opportunities and executing transactions to monetize an investment.
Summer Analyst work may include modelling and presentations to support core AM activities:
•
Building portfolio companies to manage operational real estate
•
Collaborating with portfolio company senior management to set business plans and drive performance
•
Conducting market research and analysing value creation initiatives (e.g. capital expenditure projects)
•
Execute transactions such as refinancings, recapitalizations and dispositions (including public IPOs and private market sales)
Real Estate Capital Markets
Blackstone’s Real Estate Capital Markets Group (‘CM’) leads on all debt capital initiatives for our real estate investments. A summer analyst within the CM team will gain exposure to the full lifecycle of financing real estate investments from a variety of debt capital sources, including  public market debt and equity transactions, securitizations, private market secured and unsecured credit deals.
Summer Analyst work may include:
•
Conduct financial analysis, modelling, and market research to support financing transactions and competitive analysis.
•
Prepare internal company presentations, reports, and marketing materials to solicit financing feedback.
•
Collaborate with Acquisitions and Asset Management teams to provide guidance on pricing and terms of financing.
•
Assist with the negotiation and execution of financing transactions.
Real Estate Core+
Blackstone’s Real Estate Core+ Group focuses on strategy and management of Blackstone Property Partners Europe (€8B NAV) and Blackstone European Property Income Fund (€1.4B NAV). Summer Analysts in the Real Estate Core+ team will work as part of a small, dedicated team focused on the ongoing management of the funds, including transaction execution, client meetings and marketing, as well as general fund management, portfolio management, and operational matters.
Summer Analyst work may include:
•
Collaborate with acquisitions, asset management, portfolio management, capital markets, finance, and ICS teams on all aspects of the Core+ business.
•
Support due diligence, tax structuring, debt and hedging strategies, and prepare investor materials.
•
Monitor the acquisition pipeline, investment results, and portfolio performance relative to portfolio objectives.
•
Track operating and financial data for Core+ assets, maintain liquidity analysis, and update fund models.
•
Assist with quarterly reporting to LPs, marketing materials, and stakeholder presentations.
•
Interface with internal teams, including fund operations, accounting, legal, tax, and compliance.
Qualifications
Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavours.
The successful candidate must possess:
•
Strong verbal and written communication skills
•
A desire to work in a team environment with dynamic roles
•
A basic knowledge of accounting and finance
•
Self-motivation to find solutions independently, and humility to acknowledge limits and uncertainties
•
Sincere commitment to professional development
•
Excellent attention to detail
•
Intellectual curiosity
•
Good judgement
To be considered for the 2027 Summer…

Job Description:
At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry.  Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.
The Cloudera IT team is looking for a talented, motivated, and passionate Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer to join our Technical Operations organization. In this role, you will help design and run the internal platform that our engineers and business teams rely on every day, owning the deployment, reliability, and automated management of our Linux-based infrastructure and core IT services across on‑premise and cloud. As a technical leader and subject matter expert, you’ll combine deep Linux systems experience with infrastructure-as-code, automation, and security-first thinking to build a highly available, compliant, and scalable foundation for the company.
As a Sr. Staff Platform Operations Engineer you will:
• Architect, deploy, and provide senior-level operational support for our on-premise and cloud-based Linux infrastructure and core IT services (e.g., virtualization, baremetal, storage, DNS), ensuring high availability and reliability.
• Develop, maintain, and champion our Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and automation frameworks using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and Foreman/MaaS to manage and deploy platform services.
• Implement and automate system-level security best practices, including patching, hardening, and configuration management, ensuring compliance and resilience from the ground up.
• Build and automate deployment pipelines for IT infrastructure services (e.g., system images, configuration, platform services) using tools like GitHub/Git, Ansible, and scripting tools.
• Serve as a technical Subject Matter Expert (SME), working with IT Systems, CloudOps, Security, and Engineering teams to design and implement robust, scalable, and optimal solutions.
• Participate in a shared on-call rotation to support mission-critical IT services (with clear documentation and runbooks provided).
• Create and maintain accurate documentation for automation, operational audits, and compliance.
• Design, implement, and administer enterprise storage platforms, including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage arrays, ensuring capacity, performance, data protection, and high availability for critical workloads.
• Mentor junior team members.
We are excited if you have (Required Qualifications):
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or 8+ years of equivalent experience in a large-scale enterprise environment.
• Solid experience managing hybrid infrastructure, with deep expertise in on-premise environments (virtualization, OpenStack, networking) and a strong understanding of core public cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP) and containerized platforms (Kubernetes).
• Deep, expert-level Linux systems administration experience (e.g., Red Hat, Rocky, Ubuntu) and mastery of common Command Line Interface (CLI) tools and services.
• Strong hands-on skills with Python and shell scripting, used for systems automation, tooling, and integration.
• Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and version control (GitHub/Git).
• Hands-on experience administering enterprise storage arrays, ideally including Dell PowerStore and Pure Storage FlashArray (provisioning, performance tuning, upgrades, and troubleshooting).
• A security-first mindset and experience designing, building, and operating secure, automated infrastructure.
• Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, firewalls), including public cloud equivalents.
You may also have:
• Certifications such as Red Hat (RHCE), Terraform, or public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
• Knowledge of enterprise security principles, cryptography, PKI, and operational security practices.
• Experience operating in regulated/high-governance/compliance environments (e.g., FedRAMP, PCI, ISO27001, SOC2, etc.).
• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools.
• Experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes).
• Project management experience.
• Previous experience mentoring junior team members.
This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.
About the Role:
As a Data Product Owner at Wiley, you will play a key role in ensuring our Research business has access to high-quality publishing data that supports insights, analytics and informed decision-making.
Working within the Enterprise Data & Analytics function you will own the roadmap, prioritisation and delivery of publishing data products, covering areas such as manuscript submissions, peer review, bibliometrics, sales, usage and master data.
You will collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, product owners and data engineering teams across our global organisation to translate business needs into clear technical requirements and deliver measurable value.
You will also work closely with the Director, Data Product, external partners and technology providers to improve data quality, strengthen data pipelines and ensure our data products continue to meet evolving business needs.
Job Responsibilities
• Own and manage publishing data products, including the roadmap, prioritised backlog and delivery of data warehouse tables, schemas and pipelines, ensuring they support business objectives and deliver value.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, analysts, subject matter experts and product teams to understand data needs, define requirements and identify opportunities to improve publishing insights and decision-making.
• Translate business needs into clear delivery requirements, including epics, user stories and priorities, working closely with data engineering and architecture teams to plan, coordinate and track delivery through Agile processes.
• Monitor and improve data quality, ensuring the reliability and stability of production publishing data, identifying potential issues and proactively communicating changes, trends and impacts to stakeholders.
• Support data governance and adoption, partnering with analytics product owners and business teams to improve the accessibility, consistency and effective use of publishing data across Wiley.
• Engage with internal teams, technology partners and external vendors to anticipate changes to data sources and application programming interfaces (APIs), improve data pipelines and coordinate releases across wider product and technology roadmaps.
Required Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in a technology product management or product ownership role, including responsibility for product roadmaps, backlog prioritisation and delivery.
• Demonstrated experience working with data products, data management or analytics solutions to deliver business value.
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured data, data pipelines or enterprise data platforms.
• Experience collaborating with data engineering, data architecture and analytics teams to translate business requirements into technical deliverables.
• Practical experience applying Agile product management methodologies, including writing user stories, prioritising backlogs and participating in Agile ceremonies.
• Experience engaging with stakeholders across different business functions, managing competing priorities and coordinating delivery across multiple projects.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working within academic publishing, scholarly communications or a related information services industry.
• Familiarity with publishing workflows, platforms and data, including manuscript submissions, peer review, bibliometrics, sales or content usage.
• Experience using Python for data analysis, automation or data processing.
• Familiarity with AI agents and their application to data management or analytics workflows.
• Experience working with external technology vendors, data providers or third-party integration partners.
• Experience working within global, cross-functional or matrix organisations.

We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.

Ready to build the wings that lift the world? Join Airbus as a Craft Tool Room Apprentice in Airbus Broughton and play a vital role in maintaining the  wing jigs and associated Tooling  for our A320, A330, and A350 aircraft families. This 36-month program offers valuable hands-on training, recognised qualifications, and a clear path to a rewarding career in aviation."
At Airbus, we believe a diverse workforce drives innovation. We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to thrive.  Airbus is a global pioneer in the aerospace industry, leading the way in designing, manufacturing, and delivering aerospace products across Commercial Aircraft, Helicopters, Defence, and Space sectors.
As the global center of excellence for wing manufacturing, our Broughton site delivers over 500 wing sets annually. Our apprenticeship programs are carefully designed to give you valuable practical training alongside your academic studies, setting you up for success and helping your career truly fly.
With over 17,5000 employees worldwide and as the largest aeronautics and space company in Europe, Airbus is at the forefront of the aviation industry. During your apprenticeship you will work alongside our experienced engineers and quality team to support you to complete the work safely and efficiently
What you will be doing:
As a Craft Tool Room Apprentice, you'll immerse yourself in hands-on technical experience in the workplace while completing your academic studies. This program is designed to equip you with valuable qualifications and competencies to work directly on live aircraft. You'll also benefit from our Gen A support network and learning HUB, providing additional support, events, and opportunities for all early career participants.
This 36-month apprenticeship is structured to maximise your learning and impact:
Year One: You will spend the first 12 months of your apprenticeship based at Coleg Cambria, Bersham Road, Wrexham, working towards obtaining:
• NVQ L2 diploma in Performing Engineering Operations
• City & Guild 2850 Level 2 In Machining
• Level 2 Essential Skills
This will allow you to develop the necessary skills, knowledge and experience to enable you to make an immediate contribution when you enter the workforce in the second year.
Year 2 and 3:  Your Learning Takes Flight at Broughton! Building on your foundational knowledge, you will be based at Airbus Broughton (North Wales) and you'll join our expert team of multi skilled Tool Makers within the Tool Room area, supporting the manufacture of wing skins, panels and stringers for various Airbus aircraft, working within all the Broughton production areas.  The tasks will be varied,  and will require you to apply your skills directly to live projects,  allowing you to work on the job whilst gaining the relevant skills, knowledge and experience.
This will include:
• Maintenance of the production jigs / tools, and using a variety of machines within the machine shop:
• Carrying out routine Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) and reactive breakdown repairs on all Industrial Maintenance assets within the Airbus Broughton plant, completing this to a high competent level and working in a safe and efficient manner.
• Demonstrate effective troubleshooting on all aspects of plant jigs and tools.
• Repair & maintain the build jigs and the associated tooling through the use of hand skills, engineering tools and laser trackers (non-contact measurement).
• Carrying out recertifications to the jigs and tools in order to ensure they meet the design criteria.
• We also have a machine shop consisting of various machines (both CNC and conventional) that supports the day to day running of the plant and also carrying out non contact (digital) measurements using laser trackers and a Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM).
Additionally you will also attend college on day release, working towards gaining:
• NVQ Level 3 Extended Diploma in Mechanical Manufacturing Engineering  (Machining Bias units)
• City & Guilds 2850 Level 3 Machining
Upon successful completion of your 36-month apprenticeship, you'll become a Multi skilled Tool maker working within the Tooling Operations  team supporting our world-class Airbus aircraft. You'll receive a Modern Apprenticeship Certificate, setting you up for a fantastic career.

• Achieve a minimum of five GCSEs which must include:
• Grade C or 4 in Maths (GCSE certificate only - no equivalency accepted)
• Grade C or 4 in English Language (GCSE certificate only - no equivalency accepted)
• Grade CC or 44 in Double Award Science OR Grade C/4 in Single award in Physics.
• Plus 2 other GCSEs at grade C or 4 (other qualifications that are equivalent or higher may be considered as an alternative to the additional 2 GCSE’s, preferably in a practical or technical subject (e.g., Design & Technology, Engineering, etc)

Risk and Resilience professionals help organisations prepare for uncertainty, respond effectively to disruption and protect the services their clients depend on.
This role offers a unique opportunity to understand how a global organisation manages risk, navigates challenges and builds resilience across people, processes, technology and third-party partners.
If you're someone who enjoys figuring things out, identifying patterns and improving how things work, you'll find plenty to challenge and develop you here.

• Support business risk assessments and emerging risk activities
• Produce reports, presentations and dashboards for stakeholders
• Help map critical business services across people, technology, premises and suppliers
• Contribute to business continuity and disaster recovery planning
• Support resilience testing and disruption scenarios
• Track risk actions and mitigation activities
• Collaborate with teams across the business to strengthen controls and improve resilience

• Investigating trends within risk data and presenting findings to stakeholders
• Supporting resilience exercises for critical business services
• Assessing the potential impact of technology, supplier or operational disruptions
• Creating management information and dashboards that support decision-making
• Contributing to responses to emerging risks and regulatory requirements

• Enjoy working with data and drawing meaningful conclusions
• Think critically and challenge assumptions
• Build strong relationships with others
• Stay organised and manage multiple priorities effectively
• Take a proactive approach rather than waiting to be directed
• Balance attention to detail with an understanding of the bigger picture

• Excellent attention to detail

Analog Devices is seeking an Analog Design Intern to join our Consumer Audio design team in Edinburgh.

Semtech is a global leader in high-performance analog ICs for high-speed optical and copper interconnect. As AI workloads drive exponential bandwidth growth toward 1.6T infrastructure, interconnect is becoming the major limiting factor in data center scaling, creating an unprecedented market opportunity at the intersection of technical innovation and commercial impact.
This Principal Field Applications Engineer – High-Speed Interconnect represents a pivotal strategic hire, a technical strategist and commercial catalyst positioned to drive $100M+ in design-win revenue and establish market dominance across hyperscaler data centers.
The dual mandate is clear: secure immediate design wins with Semtech's current portfolio of high-speed analog ICs for optical and copper connectivity in AI networks, while simultaneously leading long-term customer co-development initiatives that will define our competitive position in next-generation 1.6T and 3.2T connectivity.
The role also extends technical scope to support key regional accounts in PON and Mobile Transport. These engagements draw on the same underlying product families and technical skill set, high-speed analog/mixed-signal ICs, signal integrity, and optical/electrical characterisation, making this a natural extension of the core mandate.
Success requires becoming a trusted technical advisor whom Tier 1 hyperscaler customers welcome into their most confidential labs, not as a vendor, but as an extension of their design teams. You'll leverage consultative discovery to uncover the situational factors, business consequences, and decision criteria that drive customer choices.
Your technical credibility will open doors; your strategic approach will close deals. Your voice will directly influence Semtech's product roadmaps, serving as strategic advisor to VPs in sales and product lines, co-creating breakthroughs that establish Semtech as the indispensable partner for the future of data center connectivity.

Knowledge and Experience:

• Knowledge of electronic, electromechanical or mechanical components and their lifecycle risks

For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
